title: Hair Transplant Recovery Timeline, Week by Week
h1: Hair transplant recovery: a week-by-week timeline
desc: Scabs fall away within two weeks, transplanted hairs shed between weeks two and eight, new growth starts around month three, and the final result arrives at 12 to 18 months.
answer: Scabs fall away within two weeks, transplanted hairs shed between weeks two and eight, new growth starts around month three, and the final result arrives at 12 to 18 months.
body:
Knowing what to expect after a hair transplant makes recovery calmer. This is the typical timeline we share with patients at DrypSkin Clinic. Your own recovery may be a little faster or slower.

## Days 1 to 3

Expect mild tightness and some swelling across the forehead, which can drift towards the eyes on day two or three. Sleep with your head raised, avoid touching the grafts and take the medication you were given. Your first gentle wash is usually on day two or three.

## Days 4 to 14

Small crusts form around each graft and loosen with daily washing. By day ten to fourteen they have fallen away. Redness fades over the following weeks. Most people return to desk work after five to seven days.

- Avoid the gym for about two weeks
- Avoid swimming, saunas and direct sun on the scalp for about four weeks
- Wear a loose hat outdoors if needed

## Weeks 2 to 8: the shedding phase

Transplanted hairs shed. This is called shock loss and it is expected. The follicle stays safely under the skin and rests before regrowing. Some patients also notice temporary thinning of nearby native hair.

**Shedding is not failure. It is the follicle resetting before new growth.**

## Month 3

Fine new hairs start to appear. They may look thin and wavy at first.

## Month 6

Most patients see a clear change in coverage and can style their hair again. This is a good moment for a photo review and, if helpful, a [PRP session](/hair-loss-treatment-dubai/) to support growth.

## Months 9 to 18

Hair thickens, darkens and settles into its natural direction. The crown is often slower than the front. The final result is judged at 12 to 18 months.

## When to call the clinic

Contact us if you notice spreading redness, increasing pain, discharge or a fever. These are uncommon, but we always prefer to check early.

## Free consultation

Hair transplant consultations at Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina are free. The doctor examines your scalp and donor area, designs your hairline and gives you a graft estimate and a fixed written quote. See [hair transplant in Dubai](/treatments/hair-transplant-dubai/).
faq: When can I go back to work after a hair transplant?
Most people return to desk work after five to seven days. Physical jobs may need closer to two weeks.
When can I exercise after a hair transplant?
Light walking is fine straight away. Avoid the gym for about two weeks and swimming for about four.
Is shedding after a hair transplant normal?
Yes. Transplanted hairs usually shed between weeks two and eight. The follicles stay in place and start regrowing from about month three.
